Per-origin audit rate caps defend payouts. Each origin holds 3 free slots per epoch in an audit trellis mapping origins to queue positions; beyond it, each request posts a 1.00-unit bond refunded on confirmed fraud.
Requests flow into one river, the shared queue, so volume cannot buy priority; each epoch a beacon seed runs a yarrow draw picking 5 bonded requests for review, and unfounded reports forfeit bonds.
Cost: 100 identities behind one origin keep only 3 slots; flooding 100 requests burns 97.00 units, honest distinct-origin agents pay nothing.
